answers.answer: Shuffle 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards into the initial draw deck. Put the 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine. Start in 1st gear and draw 7 cards.
answers.evidence: Setup 4–8: 'Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards'; 'Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine'; 'Set Gear pawn to 1st gear'; 'Draw 7 cards'.

answers.answer: Yes, you may stay in the same gear. You may shift from 1st to 3rd by paying 1 Heat immediately during Shift Gears, moving an available Heat card from Engine to discard. You must have it in the Engine to pay.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: 'Stay in your current gear'; 'shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step: move a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile'.

answers.answer: No. With enough playable cards in 3rd gear, commit exactly 3 cards face down.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: 'Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number' and '3rd = 3'.

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 are simultaneous, in that order. Step 3 begins after everyone has completed both. Each player then completes all steps 3–9 before the next begins, front car first. Between side-by-side cars, the car closest to the Race Line acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: 'Wait until everyone has finished both steps before starting step 3.' Sequential Phase: 'Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next player begins step 3'; closest to Race Line is 'ahead for all purposes, including turn order'.

answers.answer: Cars do not block passage. If both destination spots are occupied, put your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars. Prefer the spot closest to the Race Line when available.
answers.evidence: Blocked Movement: 'Cars never block passage' and 'first free spot behind the blocking cars'. Reveal & Move: 'Place your car on the spot closest to the Race Line if available'.

answers.answer: Immediately discard the flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade cards. Put the Speed 3 card in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card, which remains underneath it. The Stress supplies speed 3. Both stay in the Play Area until discarded during Replenish Hand. Resolve this before Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: 'Immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card, including Heat, Stress and Starting Upgrade cards'; 'Put the found Speed card in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card'; 'Discard both during Replenish Hand'; resolve all Stress 'before moving on to Adrenaline'.

answers.answer: The last two cars to move receive Adrenaline in a five-car race. Each gets access to 1 extra Cooldown and may add 1 speed during React. That extra speed can be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: 'If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits'; '1 extra Cooldown' and '1 extra speed'; 'before or after Boost'; 'Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved for another round'.

answers.answer: Yes. In 2nd gear you have Cooldown 1, enough to move that one Heat from hand into Engine. During React you may use Cooldown and Boost in any order, so you can cool the card first and immediately spend it from Engine to discard to Boost.
answers.evidence: Cooldown: '2nd gear (Cooldown 1)'. React: 'Activate available Cooldown and/or Boost symbols in any order'; 'You may Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost'.

answers.answer: Boost once per turn during React by paying 1 Heat from Engine to discard. If the Engine is empty, you cannot choose Boost unless you first use available Cooldown to return Heat from hand. Flip until a Speed card appears, immediately discarding non-Speed cards; put the Speed card in the Play Area and move its value. That value increases total speed for corner checks.
answers.evidence: Boost: 'Once per turn during React, pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard'; flip until a Speed card and 'move its value'; 'Boost increases your total speed for corner checks'. Paying Heat: 'You cannot choose to Boost without a Heat card available in your Engine'; may first Cooldown.

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. Check the crossed corner at speed 6 because Slipstream movement does not increase speed. Pay 2 Heat for exceeding the limit of 4 by 2.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: 'optionally move 2 spaces forward' and 'does NOT increase your speed for corner checks', but a crossed Corner Line still requires checking. Check Corner: 'pay Heat equal to the excess'.

answers.answer: Check both corners in the order crossed: limit 6 first, then limit 4. Use speed 8 for each, paying 2 Heat and then 4 Heat, totaling 6 Heat.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: 'Check every Corner Line crossed this turn ... in the order crossed'; 'For each corner separately'; 'Use the same total speed for each corner'.

answers.answer: The corner requires 3 Heat, so with only 2 you spin out. Move both remaining Engine Heat to discard. Return the car to the first available space before that corner, take 2 extra Stress cards directly into hand because you were in 4th gear, and set your gear to 1st.
answers.evidence: Spin Out: 'move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile'; 'first available space before the corner'; '2 if you were in 3rd/4th gear' directly into hand; 'move your Gear pawn to 1st gear'.

answers.answer: You may optionally discard unwanted Speed cards from hand, but may not discard Stress or Heat. You may not browse your own or anyone else's discard pile. Only each pile's top card is public.
answers.evidence: Discard: 'Optionally discard unwanted cards from hand, but never Stress or Heat cards'; 'Nobody may browse any discard pile, including their own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge'.

answers.answer: Move all cards in the Play Area into your discard pile, then draw only enough to bring your hand to 7; do not draw seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: 'Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7. Do not draw seven additional cards'.

answers.answer: Immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new draw deck, excluding cards still in the Play Area, and continue the interrupted Stress flips.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: 'immediately shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, then continue the interrupted draws or flips'; applies to Stress; 'Do not include cards still in your Play Area'.

answers.answer: Pay Heat by moving it from Engine to discard. It can cycle from discard into the draw deck and then into hand, and returns from hand to Engine through Cooldown. Normally you cannot play Heat or voluntarily discard it from hand; the forced Cluttered Hand handling is an exception.
answers.evidence: Paying Heat: 'from your Engine to your discard pile'. Heat Card Cycle: 'Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown'. Special Rules: 'Heat cards cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand'.

answers.answer: Commit both playable cards and fill the other two required slots with Heat cards from hand. Move zero spaces, set gear to 1st, and discard all four committed cards, including the two Heat cards. Skip directly to Replenish Hand. You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: 'commit all playable cards you can and fill the remaining required slots with Heat cards'; 'moves zero spaces'; 'Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards'; 'skip directly to step 9'; 'You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn'.

answers.answer: Crossing first does not automatically win when multiple cars finish in the same round. The car furthest ahead wins, with the car closest to the Race Line winning a side-by-side tie. Finished cars are removed at the end of the round and placed in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: 'If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties)'; 'At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line'.

answers.answer: You may not Slipstream across the finish line on the final lap, and may not Slipstream after crossing it through normal movement. After crossing that final finish line, ignore corner speed limits beyond it and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: 'On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line, and cannot Slipstream after crossing it'; 'ignore the speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can'.

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline. Eligibility uses the six cars that started the race, so the last two cars to move receive the benefits even after four finishers leave.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: 'If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits'; 'Use the number of cars that started the race, even after finishers leave the track'.
